mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/cache-eviction.md <<'EOF'
# Cache Eviction Policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use an LRU (Least Recently Used) eviction policy for the cache layer, with a 300-second TTL on cache entries. When capacity is reached, the least-recently-accessed entries are evicted, and every entry expires after 300 seconds regardless of access patterns. The recorded rationale is that this is simpler to reason about, test, and debug, and gives more predictable eviction behavior.
EOF
cat docs/policies/cache-eviction.md
